text: My office received a petition from Salem Avenue residents requesting that the alternate Thursday parking regulation, which is in effect between April and November, be rescinded, between Fernbank Avenue and Dupont Street. The purpose of this motion is to have this parking regulation rescinded, as requested by residents.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Salem Avenue, between Hallam Street and Dupont Street. 2. Authorized permit parking on the east side of Salem Avenue, between Hallam Street and Dupont Street, in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily. 3. Amended the existing parking prohibition on the east side of Salem Avenue, between Fernbank Avenue and Dupont Street, in effect anytime from the 16th day to the last day of each month, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, to be in effect between Fernbank Avenue and Hallam Street. 4. Amended the existing parking prohibition on the west side of Salem Avenue, between Fernbank Avenue and Dupont Street, in effect anytime from the 1st day to the 15th day of each month, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, to be in effect between Fernbank Avenue and Hallam Street. 5.
